caption_zh: 三种场景中与实际运动事件对应的轨迹及航向误差。左列在米尺度展示事件期间参考与本文的局部轨迹，等长箭头为机身航向，小窗定位完整路线；右列上方展示本文与两种双位置IEKF的航向误差，下方给出同一事件的位置误差。前两行使用仅由参考姿态确认的首个20秒转弯；第三行展示首个登记遮挡及前后各10秒，灰色表示实际遮挡。空间误差很小时轨迹重合是预期现象，右列以角度和厘米直接量化。误差保留各方法冻结评价契约，局部窗口不用于重新定义全窗排名。
caption_en: Event-aligned routes and navigation errors. The left column shows metre-scale local reference and LegSA-GINS trajectories with body-heading arrows and a small full-route locator. The right panels show heading and horizontal-position errors for LegSA-GINS and both dual-position IEKF parameter settings during the same event. The first two events are the first reference-confirmed 20-s turns; the third spans the first registered antenna obstruction with 10 s of context on each side. Gray shading denotes the registered obstruction. Equal-length arrows encode body direction, not speed. Frozen evaluation contracts are retained; event selection does not use estimator errors.
position_contract: Local reference and V3 at archived POI. External horizontal errors retain frozen own evaluator contract; no external coordinate path reconstructed.
